title:
A set of highlighted line and/or column ranges.

One or more line ranges can be be specified, separated by commas. Lines are 1-based and ranges are inclusive:
 - `3` just the third line
 - `2-4` lines 2, 3, and 4 (inclusive)
 - `1,5` the first and fifth lines only

Here we're highlighting the key lines in the Christmas rhyme (1-2, 9, 13):

```song highlight={1-2, 9, 13}
On the twelveth day of Christmas, my true love gave to me:
  Twelve drummers drumming,
  Eleven pipers piping,
  Ten lords a-leaping,
  Nine ladies dancing,
  Eight maids a-milking,
  Seven swans a-swimming,
  Six geese a-laying,
  Five golden rings;
  Four calling birds,
  Three french hens,
  Two turtle doves,
  And a partridge in a pear tree.
```

It is also possible to specify spans within the line using a period to separate the line number and character
number (also 1-based). For example, in the snippet below the return value expression is specified by `2.12-2.16`.

```py highlight={2.12-2.16}
def sum(a, b)
    return a + b
```

If code syntax highlighting does not support column ranges, the whole line is highlighted instead.

Leading zeros in numbers and spaces around dashes and commas are ignored.

Full-line ranges that overlap are merged. For example, "1-2, 2.3-2.8, 3-4, 1-4" becomes "1-4, 2.3-2.8".
This does _not_ merge adjacent ranges nor does it touch ranges with columns.
